18 Pride goeth before destruction, and an haughty spirit before a fall. (Proverbs 16:18 KJV)

What a tremendous truth this is, as people who get carried away with pride, are always setting themselves up for a failure. God can humble the proud, and exalt the humble, as shown many times in the bible. You can’t be carried away with pride, and obey the commands that Jesus gave, to love God above all, and others as yourself (Matthew 22:37-40). Jesus said “if you love me, you will follow my commands” (John 14:15), and you must obey Jesus to assure your eternal salvation (Hebrews 5:9). Pride is being self-centered, and thinking only of what you want. It is a predominant problem in this world today, as we are living in the “me” generation, where it is all about us, and what we want. You should never think more highly of yourself, than what you truly are, as that goes against all the teachings of Jesus. These traits of pride and haughtiness are so common in the world today that they are even promoted, and we are told that we need to have great self-esteem, and be proud. Follow the example of the Lord, and stay humble (Matthew 11:29), and full of God’s kind of love. To be full of God, you have to be full of love, as God is Love (1 John 4:8).
